# Mahj Trainer: Mahjong Practice

> Mahj Trainer is a free American Mah Jongg practice app for iPhone, iPad and Android. Five-minute drills on tiles, the card, the Charleston and keep-or-throw calls.

## App

- [Mahj Trainer: American Mahjong Practice App for iPhone](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/index.html.md): Mahj Trainer is a free American Mah Jongg practice app for iPhone, iPad and Android. Five-minute drills on tiles, the card, the Charleston and keep-or-throw calls.

## Guides

- [American Mahjong Practice App for Android: Mahj Trainer](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/american-mahjong-practice-app-android.html.md): American mahjong practice app for Android: Mahj Trainer is on Google Play with five-minute drills on racks, the Charleston and discards. No account needed.
- [American Mahjong Apps Compared: 2026 Card, Bots, Friends](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/best-american-mahjong-app.html.md): Twelve American Mah Jongg apps for iPhone and iPad compared on the 2026 NMJL card, bots, online play with friends, lessons and price model, as of November 2026.
- [Mahj Trainer for ChatGPT](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/chatgpt/index.html.md): Mahj Trainer teaches American mah jongg inside ChatGPT: short lessons, practice quizzes, a rack reader for the card's sections, and a glossary.
- [Mahj Trainer for Claude](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/claude/index.html.md): Mahj Trainer teaches American mah jongg inside Claude: short lessons, practice quizzes, a rack reader for the card's sections, and a glossary.
- [Free American Mahjong App With No Subscription](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/free-american-mahjong-app.html.md): Mahj Trainer is a free American mahjong learning app: four beginner rooms with no subscription, account or ads. Here is what is free and what Mahj+ adds.
- [How to Build the Wall and Deal in American Mahjong](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/learn/building-the-wall.html.md): How to set up American mahjong: build four walls 19 tiles long and two high, choose East, break the wall with two dice, and deal 14 tiles to East, 13 to the rest.
- [When Can You Call a Discard in Mahjong?](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/learn/calling-a-discard.html.md): You can call the latest discard until the next player racks their drawn tile. What you can call for, who wins a tie, and when calling is not allowed.
- [How to Read the Mah Jongg Card: the 9 Sections Explained](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/learn/card-sections.html.md): How to read the NMJL card: the nine sections that keep their shape every year, from 2468 and Like Numbers to Quints and Singles and Pairs.
- [The Charleston in American Mah Jongg: Rules, Order and Strategy](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/learn/charleston.html.md): How the Charleston works in American Mah Jongg: the three passes, the optional second Charleston, blind and courtesy passes, and which tiles to pass.
- [What Is a Dead Hand in Mahjong? Causes and Rules](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/learn/dead-hand.html.md): A dead hand in American mahjong can no longer legally win. What makes a hand dead, who can call it, what the dead player still pays, and its jokers.
- [Mahjong Exposure Rules: Can You Add to a Pung?](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/learn/exposure-rules.html.md): Exposure rules in American mahjong: you expose only by calling a discard, you can change a group until you discard, and after that it is locked.
- [How Many Flowers in American Mahjong? Flower Rules](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/learn/flowers.html.md): American mahjong uses eight flowers, and every flower counts as the same tile. How flowers are passed, called and used, and why some sets have sixteen.
- [American Mah Jongg Glossary: Soap, Pung, Kong and More](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/learn/glossary.html.md): A plain-English glossary of American Mah Jongg terms: craks, bams, dots, soap, pung, kong, quint, exposure, Charleston, blind pass, joker swap and more.
- [How to Play American Mah Jongg: Rules for Beginners (2026 Guide)](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/learn/how-to-play-american-mahjong.html.md): The rules of American Mah Jongg in plain English: the 152 tiles, the card, the Charleston, calling, jokers, and how a hand is won. For brand-new players.
- [Learn American Mah Jongg: Rules, Card, Jokers and Scoring](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/learn/index.html.md): Free American Mah Jongg guides from Mahj Trainer: how to play, reading the card's nine sections, the Charleston, joker rules, scoring and a full glossary.
- [Mahjong Joker Exchange Rules: How a Swap Works](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/learn/joker-exchange.html.md): How to exchange a joker in American mahjong: on your turn, before you discard, trade the real tile for a joker in any exposure, even your own.
- [Joker Rules in American Mah Jongg: Where They Can and Cannot Go](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/learn/jokers.html.md): Every joker rule in American Mah Jongg: groups of three or more only, never in pairs or singles, never passed in the Charleston, and how joker swaps work.
- [What Happens If You Call Mahjong Wrong?](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/learn/mahjong-in-error.html.md): Called mah jongg by mistake? Catch it before your tiles go down and play goes on. Once you expose a wrong hand it is dead, and you still pay the winner.
- [What Is a Quint in Mahjong? Five of a Kind Rules](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/learn/quints.html.md): A quint is five identical tiles. Only four of each tile exist, so a quint needs at least one joker, unless it is flowers. Calling, exposing and joker tips.
- [American Mah Jongg Scoring and Table Rules: Who Pays What](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/learn/scoring-and-table-rules.html.md): How payment works when someone wins at American Mah Jongg, when a call is too late, what happens after a wrong mah jongg, dead hands, and wall games.
- [What Is Soap in Mahjong? The White Dragon Explained](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/learn/soap-in-mahjong.html.md): Soap is the White Dragon in American mahjong. It is the Dots suit's dragon and it stands in as zero in year hands. How to use it and read it on the card.
- [Is There an App to Practice the Mahjong Charleston?](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/mahjong-charleston-practice-app.html.md): Mahj Trainer is a free iPhone, iPad and Android app to practice the American mahjong Charleston: deal, pick three tiles, see the coach's reasoning.
- [Mahjong Practice App for iPad: Mahj Trainer (Free)](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/mahjong-practice-app-ipad.html.md): Mahjong practice app for iPad: Mahj Trainer is a free American mahjong app with five-minute drills, an iPad layout, no opponents and no account. Works offline.
- [Mahjong Quiz App That Explains Every Answer](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/mahjong-quiz-app.html.md): Mahj Trainer is an American mahjong quiz app that explains why each answer is right and why a missed pick does not fit. Free beginner rooms, iPhone and iPad.
- [How to Practice American Mahjong Alone, Without a Group](https://jackwallner.com/ios/mahj/practice-american-mahjong-alone.html.md): Practice American mahjong alone with Mahj Trainer, a free app of five-minute drills on racks, Charleston passes and discards. No opponents or account needed.
